Step 1: 40 weeks = 40 × 7 = 280 days.  
Step 2: Add 1 more day → total 281 days.  
Step 3: 03-12-1023 is December 3, 1023 (assuming DD-MM-YYYY).  
Step 4: Add 281 days:  
- December 3, 1023 + 281 days.  
- Dec 3 → Dec 31 = 28 days left in Dec (non-leap year 1024? Actually 1023 is not divisible by 4, so 1023 is not leap; 1024 is leap but we start in 1023).  
- 281 − 28 = 253 days left.  
- Jan 1, 1024 → 1024 is leap year (divisible by 4).  
- Jan (31) + Feb (29) + Mar (31) + Apr (30) + May (31) + Jun (30) + Jul (31) + Aug (31) = 31+29+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 244 days.  
- 253 − 244 = 9 days into September 1024.  
- September 1 + 9 days = September 10, 1024.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1024-09-10
